description: Extracts every JSON-LD block on a page, lists the schema.org types it describes, flags missing required and recommended properties (Organization, LocalBusiness, Article, FAQPage, Product, Service, Person, BreadcrumbList, Event) and scores entity signals: a named organisation, sameAs links to other profiles, a logo and an @id. Free, no key. Docs: https://aeolookup.com/aeo-tools/schema-checker/

url.description: The page or site to check, for example https://example.co.uk/ (https:// is added if missing).

name: check_structured_data
title: Schema checker
